name: quality-code
description: From a Jira ticket to graded tests, for any project. Setup, a daily start from your feature branch (connectors, branch changes, ticket from the branch name), the readiness gate (70 points, Gherkin or 150+ characters of plain criteria), guided fill-in, Jira comment and push.
